visual.nota: Energy in and out, almost no matter: closed

turnos.t: Is Earth open, closed or isolated? Closed, almost. It receives energy as solar radiation and loses heat to space, but exchanges almost no matter: a little arrives as meteorites, and a little gas escapes.
Four interacting spheres: atmosphere, hydrosphere, biosphere and geosphere. Kognity adds the cryosphere and the anthroposphere. A change in one sphere affects the others.
